description.value: The Schooner is one of Tofino's oldest and most storied restaurants, operating since 1949 and celebrating 70 years in 2019. Specializing in regional West Coast cuisine and seafood, the building itself has a colourful history — originally constructed as a WWII RCAF hospital and later home to a resident ghost named Morris. A family-run institution since 1968, it remains a landmark gathering place on the corner of Campbell and Second Street in the heart of Tofino.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms an active restaurant with delivery/takeout navigation, a reservation system, and a rich history page. The website contact page lists the address as '331 Campbell St.' while OSM records '331 Second Street'; the history page clarifies the building sits on the corner of Campbell and Second Street, but the website's own address is used as primary. No mention of bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists '331 Second Street' but the restaurant's own website contact page lists '331 Campbell St.' The history page confirms the building is on the corner of Campbell and Second Street; the website address has been used as primary.
Phone number not present in OSM tags; sourced from website contact page only (250-725-3444).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, well-established, publicly accessible restaurant with an active website and reservation system. Straightforwardly includable.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM outdoor_seating=yes tag is consistent with a restaurant of this type but not explicitly corroborated by website text.
